edits.description: Restored the complete contiguous monochrome Window Manager interval, from NewString through DrawGrowIcon. Retained the released header, history through November 1985, applicable routine contracts, and matching comments. The eight-byte WMgrGray pattern retains the original DC.W values.

Matched operations within corresponding released routines using resolved equates and operand values. The ROM determines branch targets, widths, stack frames, direct calls, and instruction encodings. A recorded source operation may have a different encoding in the later source. Omitted comments about removed color, layer, display, palette, and help-manager paths.

Restored CalcVis, CalcVBehind, PaintBehind, CheckUpdate, FrontWindow, and NewWindow from the ROM. The released history records deletion or replacement of classic bodies; the reconstructed file identifies these routines. Related surviving helpers retain their original comments and symbolic operands.

Restored InitWindows with one monochrome manager port, the desktop pattern, rounded screen corners, CalcMBHeight and DrawMBar calls, and classic window globals. The ROM supplies the older drawing and initialization sequence.

Restored NewWindow allocation or caller-supplied storage, record initialization, WDEF lookup with fallback, title creation, window-list insertion, activation, and drawing. The released NewWindow entry delegates to NewWindowCommon in the layer manager and no longer contains this body.
Restored CallWindow before GetWVariant and cache-flush changes. It reads the variant from the high byte of WindowDef and changes the master pointer lock bit directly around the WDEF call.

Restored classic movement, sizing, zooming, activation, update, and hit-test paths. FindWindow tests the menu bar directly before asking visible windows for hit results. EORSymbol retains the ROM word move into D3; the later source also clears the high word.

Restored the original DragTheRgn loop and delay behavior. Expanded its parameter-record offsets into equates and restored its 20-byte local frame. GrowWindow uses a 28-byte frame and one saved pen state. The later saved color pen state and mouse-size exceptions are absent.

Replaced later build includes with required released equates and external ROM entry addresses. Used OPWORD for A-line traps and explicit PC addressing for code and pattern references. Every instruction is assembled; the sole data directive is the original gray pattern.
